parameters.description:
`msg-to-ifttt` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your IFTTT destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through [Apprise](https://github.com/caronc/apprise) — the open-source notification library — or a native gateway transformation, both free and driven entirely by your own stored credentials. Paid variants ($0.001 per message) deliver to additional IFTTT destinations bound per enrollment.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment IFTTT destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your IFTTT Webhooks endpoint
parameters.gateway_url_plus: ${ customer_secrets.IFTTT_WEBHOOK_BASE ?? https://maker.ifttt.com }/trigger/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.event_secret }} }/with/key/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.webhook_id_secret }} }
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own IFTTT destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

event_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's IFTTT event name

events_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's IFTTT events

webhook_id_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's IFTTT webhook id
